svg.title: MT-DARTS complete architecture diagram
svg.desc: Single unified diagram covering the full MT-DARTS framework: input with task_id, shared stem, MixedOp cell stack with 5-op search space and softmax weighting, per-task alpha slices, three task heads, bilevel SearchController with gradient disentanglement gate, and discretize output.

g.text: shared weights · task-partitioned alphas [T=3, L=4, O=5]

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the input to MT-DARTS?')
sendPrompt('What does the stem do in MT-DARTS?')
sendPrompt('How is the alpha tensor used per task?')
sendPrompt('How does Phase 1 weight update work?')
sendPrompt('How does Phase 2 alpha update enforce disentanglement?')
sendPrompt('What is gradient disentanglement and why does it matter for multi-task NAS?')
sendPrompt('How does discretize() extract the final model?')
g.text: argmax α[k, l] per layer → clean nn.Sequential (detached)
